newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas up sharply on Cr. du Nord news.
newsitem.headline: Paribas up sharply on Cr. du Nord news.

text.p: Shares in Cie Financiere de Paribas were sharply higher after the company said on Thursday it planned to sell its Credit du Nord unit to Societe Generale.
Paribas and Societe Generale said earlier they approved the start of talks aimed at reaching a quick agreement for Paribas to sell Credit du Nord to Societe Generale for 2.2 billion francs.
"It's very good news for Paribas," said one trader.

"Soc Gen had been under pressure recently on talk they were going to take over (French insurer GAN's banking unit) CIC and people were shorting Soc Gen on the back of that rumour," a trader said. He added that now that Societe Generale was committed to Credit du Nord, markets were less worried about a CIC bid.
At 0950 GMT, Paribas shares were 3.88 percent higher at 353.7 francs off their high of the day of 355.6 francs.
Societe General shares were also higher, trading 3.52 percent higher at 559 francs.
